newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil real ends off 0.05 pct on lower mini-band.
newsitem.headline: Brazil real ends off 0.05 pct on lower mini-band.

text.p: Brazil's real fell 0.05 percent to close at 1.0431 per dollar in the commercial forex market after the Central Bank set a weaker mini-band for the currency at 1.0430 to 1.0480 per dollar, dealers said.
The previous mini-band was set on January 15 between 1.0425 and 1.0475 reais to the dollar.
Although dealers had expected a 0.1 percent lowering of the mini-band, today's 0.05 percent drop was seen as a sign that the Central Bank is not speeding up the mini-band devaluations.
So far this month, the mini-band has been lowered 0.38 percent. In the last few months, the mini-band was lowered between 0.50 percent and 0.65 percent.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0484 to the dollar, up 0.01 percent.
In the illegal parallel market, the real rose 0.18 percent to end at 1.098 per dollar.
